section.title: org.osgi.service.enocean.descriptions
section.para: EnOcean Descriptions Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.enocean.descriptions; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.enocean.descriptions; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

listitem.para: EnOceanChannelDescription - Public and registered description interface for a channel.
EnOceanChannelDescriptionSet - This interface represents an EnOcean Channel Description Set.
EnOceanChannelEnumValue - This transitional interface is used to define all the possible values taken by an enumerated channel.
EnOceanDataChannelDescription - Subinterface of {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} that describes physical measuring channels.
EnOceanEnumChannelDescription - Subinterface of {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} that describes enumerated channels.
EnOceanFlagChannelDescription - Subinterface of {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} that describes boolean channels.
EnOceanMessageDescription - This interface represents an EnOcean Message Description.
EnOceanMessageDescriptionSet - This interface represents an EnOcean Message Description Set.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanChannelDescription
section.para: Public and registered description interface for a channel. Encompasses all the possible subtypes for a channel.

section.title: public static final String CHANNEL_ID = "enocean.channel.description.channel_id"
section.para: The unique ID of this EnOceanChannelDescription object.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_DATA = "enocean.channel.description.data"
section.para: A DATA channel maps itself to a {@link Double} value representing a physical measure.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_ENUM = "enocean.channel.description.enum"
section.para: An ENUM channel maps itself to one between a list of discrete {@link EnOceanChannelEnumValue} "value objects".

section.title: public static final String TYPE_FLAG = "enocean.channel.description.flag"
section.para: A FLAG channel maps itself to a {@link Boolean} value.

section.title: public static final String TYPE_RAW = "enocean.channel.description.raw"
section.para: A RAW channel is only made of bytes.

section.title: public abstract Object deserialize(byte[][] bytes)
section.para: Tries to deserialize a series of bytes into a documented value object (raw bytes, Double or {@link EnOceanChannelEnumValue}. Of course this method will be specialized for each {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} subinterface, depending on the type of this channel.

section.title: public abstract String getType()
section.para: Retrieves the type of the channel.

section.title: public abstract byte[][] serialize(Object obj)
section.para: Tries to serialize the channel into a series of bytes.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the right-aligned value, in raw bytes, of the channel.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanChannelDescriptionSet
section.para: This interface represents an EnOcean Channel Description Set. {@link EnOceanChannelDescriptionSet} is registered as an OSGi Service. Provides a method to retrieve the {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} objects it documents.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanChannelDescription getChannelDescription(String channelId)

formalpara.title: channelId
formalpara.para: the unique string identifier of the description object.

section.para: Retrieves a {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} object according to its identifier.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The corresponding {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} object, or null.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the supplied String is invalid, null, or other reason.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanChannelEnumValue
section.para: This transitional interface is used to define all the possible values taken by an enumerated channel.

section.title: public abstract String getDescription()
section.para: A non-mandatory description of what this enumerated value is about.

section.title: public abstract int getStart()
section.para: The start value of the enumeration.

section.title: public abstract int getStop()
section.para: The stop value of the enumeration.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanDataChannelDescription extends EnOceanChannelDescription
section.para: Subinterface of {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} that describes physical measuring channels.

section.title: public abstract int getDomainStart()
section.para: The start of the raw input range for this channel.

section.title: public abstract int getDomainStop()
section.para: The end of the raw input range for this channel.

section.title: public abstract double getRangeStart()
section.para: The scale start at which this channel will be mapped to (-20,0°C for instance)

section.title: public abstract double getRangeStop()
section.para: The scale stop at which this channel will be mapped to (+30,0°C for instance)

section.title: public abstract String getUnit()
section.para: The non-mandatory physical unit description of this channel.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanEnumChannelDescription extends EnOceanChannelDescription
section.para: Subinterface of {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} that describes enumerated channels.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanChannelEnumValue[][] getPossibleValues()
section.para: Gets all the possible value for this channel.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanFlagChannelDescription extends EnOceanChannelDescription
section.para: Subinterface of {@link EnOceanChannelDescription} that describes boolean channels.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanMessageDescription
section.para: This interface represents an EnOcean Message Description.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanChannel[][] deserialize(byte[][] bytes)
section.para: Deserializes an array of bytes into the EnOceanChannels available to the payload, if possible.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the actual instance type of the message is not compatible with the bytes it is fed with (RORG to begin with).

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the message description containing the RORG, (and the FUNC, and the TYPE if available), as well as, the EEP's "title" (e.g. for F60201: Rocker Switch, 2 Rocker; Light and Blind Control - Application Style 1).

section.title: public abstract byte[][] serialize(EnOceanChannel[][] channels)
section.para: Serializes a series of {@link EnOceanChannel} objects into the corresponding byte[] sequence.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if the given channels is null.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanMessageDescriptionSet
section.para: This interface represents an EnOcean Message Description Set. {@link EnOceanMessageDescriptionSet} is registered as an OSGi Service. Provides method to retrieve the {@link EnOceanMessageDescription} objects it documents.

section.title: public abstract EnOceanMessageDescription getMessageDescription(int rorg, int func, int type, int extra)

formalpara.title: rorg
formalpara.para: the radio telegram type of the message.

formalpara.title: func
formalpara.para: The func subtype of this message.

formalpara.title: extra
formalpara.para: Some extra information; some {@link EnOceanMessageDescription} objects need an additional specifier. If not needed, has to be set to -1.

section.para: Retrieves a {@link EnOceanMessageDescription} object according to its identifiers. See EnOcean Equipment Profile Specification for more details.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The {@link EnOceanMessageDescription} object looked for, or null.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if there was an error related to the input arguments.
